paths.name: react
paths.message: Meowland components use meowjsx. React is not a dependency.

paths.name: react-dom
paths.message: DOM mounting comes from meowjsx/web. Do not import react-dom.

paths.name: react/jsx-runtime
paths.message: JSX compiles to the meowjsx factory (h). Do not import React's JSX runtime.

paths.name: react/jsx-dev-runtime
paths.message: JSX compiles to the meowjsx factory (h). Do not import React's JSX runtime.
